name: Law of Continuity (Good Continuation)
axiom: Marks along one smooth path read as a single line, not a series.
trigger: Numbers in a table centre-align, so the decimal points stagger down the column.

checklist.text: Right-align numeric columns and use tabular figures so digits stack in one plane.
Run onboarding steps along one visible axis instead of wrapping them into a grid.
Keep scan paths predictable; do not break a column of links with a full-width banner.
Track a reader's eye across a dense screen; sideways jumps mark a broken continuation.

antiPattern.violation: A ledger centres its figures, the decimal points stagger, and the column cannot be scanned.
antiPattern.remediation: Every amount is right-aligned in tabular figures, forming one vertical line of decimals.

academicOrigin.title: Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II
